subject.title: Renderer placeholder leak: `(see attached image)`, `Image reply`, `Audio reply`, `Media reply` leak to human-visible Telegram reply under specific content-classification paths

question: Should this issue remain blocked on a redacted current-main final reply payload and Telegram Bot API capture before any shared renderer or Telegram code is changed?
rationale: Current source inspection does not reproduce the reported boundary crossing, and changing either the multimodal prompt placeholders or WebChat transcript labels without the payload trace could alter unrelated supported behavior.

options.title: Require the payload trace
options.body: Keep the issue open and obtain the normalized reply payload plus Telegram request before selecting the repair owner or implementation boundary.

options.title: Sponsor a maintainer reproduction
options.body: Have a Telegram owner reproduce the directive/media case on current main and publish a redacted trace if the reporter cannot capture it.

options.title: Treat as related model-context work
options.body: Move investigation to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99241 only if evidence shows the symptom never reaches Telegram’s outbound request.

recommendation.title: Require the payload trace
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and obtain the normalized reply payload plus Telegram request before selecting the repair owner or implementation boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work covers Telegram rich-message rendering and the outbound presentation surface closest to the claimed symptom.
